WITH lead_context AS (
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id,
  l.whatsapp_name,
  l.phone_number,
  l.service,
  l.city,
  l.requirement,
  l.qualification_context,
  l.channel,
  l.source_number_id,
  l.clickup_task_id,
  l.clickup_task_url,
  s.id AS seller_id,
  s.name AS seller_name,
  s.clickup_user_id,
  s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT string_agg(
        CONCAT(
          to_char(COALESCE(m.external_timestamp, m.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
          ' ',
          CASE WHEN m.direction = 'incoming' THEN 'Cliente' ELSE 'Bot' END,
          ': ',
          COALESCE(m.text_body, CONCAT('[', m.message_type, ']'))
        ),
        E'\n'
        ORDER BY COALESCE(m.external_timestamp, m.created_at)
      )
      FROM messages m
      LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
      WHERE (m.lead_id = l.id OR c.lead_id = l.id)
        AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND m.created_at >= COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT previous.created_at
            FROM leads previous
            WHERE previous.phone_number = l.phone_number
              AND previous.id <> l.id
              AND previous.created_at < l.created_at
              AND previous.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY previous.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
          ),
          c.started_at,
          l.created_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
        )
        AND m.created_at <= l.created_at + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS full_conversation,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'attachment_id', ma.id,
          'attachment_type', ma.attachment_type,
          'mime_type', ma.mime_type,
          'filename', ma.filename,
          'external_media_id', ma.external_media_id,
          'external_url', ma.external_url,
          'file_size', ma.file_size
        )
      )
      FROM message_attachments ma
      JOIN messages m ON m.id = ma.message_id
      LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
      WHERE (m.lead_id = l.id OR c.lead_id = l.id)
        AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND m.created_at >= COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT previous.created_at
            FROM leads previous
            WHERE previous.phone_number = l.phone_number
              AND previous.id <> l.id
              AND previous.created_at < l.created_at
              AND previous.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY previous.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
          ),
          c.started_at,
          l.created_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
        )
        AND m.created_at <= l.created_at + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS attachments_json,
  COALESCE(latest_ad.output_payload, '{}'::jsonb) AS advisor_output_payload,
  COALESCE(latest_ad.input_payload, '{}'::jsonb) AS advisor_input_payload,
  latest_ad.validation_result AS advisor_validation_result
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = l.assigned_seller_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    ad.output_payload,
    ad.input_payload,
    ad.validation_result
  FROM advisor_decisions ad
  LEFT JOIN conversations c_ad ON c_ad.id = ad.conversation_id
  WHERE ad.lead_id = l.id
    OR c_ad.lead_id = l.id
  ORDER BY ad.created_at DESC, ad.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) latest_ad ON TRUE
WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
  AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
),
operation_seed AS (
  INSERT INTO external_operations (
    operation_key, operation_type, entity_type, entity_id, status, external_id, external_url,
    attempt_count, locked_at, completed_at
  )
  SELECT
    'clickup-task:lead:' || lc.lead_id::text, 'clickup_task_create', 'lead', lc.lead_id,
    CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'succeeded' ELSE 'processing' END,
    lc.clickup_task_id, lc.clickup_task_url,
    CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END
  FROM lead_context lc
  ON CONFLICT (operation_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *, TRUE AS claimed_now
),
ambiguous_stale AS (
  UPDATE external_operations eo
  SET status = 'unknown',
      reconciliation_required = TRUE,
      reconciliation_reason = COALESCE(eo.reconciliation_reason, 'stale_processing_without_provider_result'),
      retry_safe = FALSE,
      last_error = COALESCE(eo.last_error, 'Provider outcome is unknown; manual reconciliation required'),
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_context lc
  WHERE eo.operation_key = 'clickup-task:lead:' || lc.lead_id::text
    AND eo.status = 'processing'
    AND eo.locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  RETURNING eo.*, FALSE AS claimed_now
),
operation_claim AS (
  UPDATE external_operations eo
  SET status = CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'succeeded' ELSE 'processing' END,
      external_id = COALESCE(lc.clickup_task_id, eo.external_id),
      external_url = COALESCE(lc.clickup_task_url, eo.external_url),
      attempt_count = CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NULL THEN eo.attempt_count + 1 ELSE eo.attempt_count END,
      locked_at = CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE eo.locked_at END,
      completed_at = CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(eo.completed_at, NOW()) ELSE NULL END,
      last_error = CASE WHEN lc.clickup_task_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE eo.last_error END,
      reconciliation_required = FALSE,
      reconciliation_reason = NULL,
      retry_safe = FALSE,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_context lc
  WHERE eo.operation_key = 'clickup-task:lead:' || lc.lead_id::text
    AND (
      lc.clickup_task_id IS NOT NULL
      OR eo.status = 'pending'
      OR (eo.status = 'failed' AND eo.retry_safe = TRUE)
    )
  RETURNING eo.*, TRUE AS claimed_now
),
effective_operation AS (
  SELECT * FROM ambiguous_stale
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM operation_seed
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM operation_claim
  UNION ALL
  SELECT eo.*, FALSE AS claimed_now
  FROM external_operations eo
  JOIN lead_context lc ON eo.operation_key = 'clickup-task:lead:' || lc.lead_id::text
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ambiguous_stale)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operation_seed)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operation_claim)
)
SELECT lc.*,
  eo.operation_key AS clickup_operation_key,
  eo.status AS clickup_operation_status,
  eo.reconciliation_required AS clickup_reconciliation_required,
  eo.reconciliation_reason AS clickup_reconciliation_reason,
  COALESCE(lc.clickup_task_id, eo.external_id) AS existing_clickup_task_id,
  COALESCE(lc.clickup_task_url, eo.external_url) AS existing_clickup_task_url,
  (lc.clickup_task_id IS NULL AND eo.status = 'processing' AND eo.claimed_now) AS should_create_clickup
FROM lead_context lc
LEFT JOIN effective_operation eo ON TRUE;

WITH operation_update AS (
  UPDATE external_operations eo
  SET status = CASE
        WHEN $11::boolean THEN eo.status
        WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'succeeded'
        WHEN $14::text = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown'
        ELSE 'failed'
      END,
      external_id = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), eo.external_id) ELSE eo.external_id END,
      external_url = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), eo.external_url) ELSE eo.external_url END,
      completed_at = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(eo.completed_at, NOW()) ELSE eo.completed_at END,
      last_error = CASE WHEN $11::boolean OR $2::boolean THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(($7::jsonb->>'response_body'), '') END,
      reconciliation_required = $15::boolean,
      reconciliation_reason = CASE WHEN $15::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(($7::jsonb->>'response_body'), ''), 'Manual reconciliation required') ELSE NULL END,
      retry_safe = $16::boolean,
      response_payload = COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE eo.operation_key = $12::text
  RETURNING eo.id
),
updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET clickup_task_id = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), l.clickup_task_id) ELSE l.clickup_task_id END,
      clickup_task_url = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), l.clickup_task_url) ELSE l.clickup_task_url END,
      lead_status_id = CASE WHEN $11::boolean OR $15::boolean THEN l.lead_status_id ELSE ls.id END,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
    AND ls.code = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'created_in_clickup' ELSE 'error' END
    AND NOT $11::boolean
  RETURNING l.id, l.clickup_task_id, l.clickup_task_url
),
resolved_lead AS (
  SELECT id, clickup_task_id, clickup_task_url FROM updated_lead
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.id, l.clickup_task_id, l.clickup_task_url
  FROM leads l
  WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
    AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_lead)
),
audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_name, entity_type, entity_id, actor_type, actor_id, result, before_payload, after_payload, metadata)
  SELECT $5::text, 'lead', ul.id, 'system', 'n8n', $6::text, '{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($8::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM updated_lead ul
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT rl.id AS lead_id, rl.clickup_task_id, rl.clickup_task_url, ai.id AS audit_id,
  $9::boolean AS comment_enabled, $10::text AS comment_text, $13::boolean AS idempotent_replay,
  $14::text AS operation_outcome, $15::boolean AS reconciliation_required,
  $16::boolean AS retry_safe, $11::boolean AS idempotency_in_progress
FROM resolved_lead rl
LEFT JOIN audit_insert ai ON TRUE;
